issue_request: FHIR-7365 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction for the References page asking to change "External references - references from resources found elsewhere" to "External references - references to resources found elsewhere" because references are described as going from a source resource to a target resource.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 6454. Git-svn commit 4b00344e8bcf6a9da4bac46cbce7984d45c8c6d2 maps to build@6454 and changed source/references.html from "references from resources found elsewhere" to "references to resources found elsewhere".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Reference datatype page to references, so source/references.html is build-scoped. Commit 2319e45e4115705f873661fe217ae2971eebc13f later removed the old internal/external reference bullet list and replaced it with resource/canonical reference wording. Current source/references.html still states that references go from source to target and frames resource references as references to other resources. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting later decision or discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested correction was already applied and the current build-scoped source no longer contains the erroneous wording.
